| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary sensor input | `tps1_1AdcChannel` | choice |  | First analog throttle body, first sensor. See also pedalPositionAdcChannel Analog TPS inputs have 200Hz low-pass cutoff. https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~analog_inputs |
| Primary closed | `tpsMin` | V | 0 … 5 | Closed voltage for primary throttle position sensor |
| Primary open | `tpsMax` | V | 0 … 5 | Fully opened voltage for primary throttle position sensor |
| Secondary sensor input | `tps1_2AdcChannel` | choice |  | First throttle body, second sensor. https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~analog_inputs |
| Secondary closed | `tps1SecondaryMin` | V | 0 … 5 | Closed voltage for secondary throttle position sensor |
| Secondary open | `tps1SecondaryMax` | V | 0 … 5 | Fully opened voltage for secondary throttle position sensor |
| Primary sensor | `tps2_1AdcChannel` | choice |  | Second throttle body position sensor, single channel so far https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~analog_inputs |
| Primary min | `tps2Min` | V | 0 … 5 | Closed voltage for primary throttle position sensor |
| Primary max | `tps2Max` | V | 0 … 5 | Fully opened voltage for primary throttle position sensor |
| Secondary sensor | `tps2_2AdcChannel` | choice |  | Second throttle body, second sensor. https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~analog_inputs |
| Secondary min | `tps2SecondaryMin` | V | 0 … 5 | Closed voltage for secondary throttle position sensor |
| Secondary max | `tps2SecondaryMax` | V | 0 … 5 | Fully opened voltage for secondary throttle position sensor |
| TPS/PPS minimum valid value | `tpsErrorDetectionTooLow` | % | -10 … 0 | TPS error detection: what throttle % is unrealistically low? Also used for accelerator pedal error detection if so equipped. |
| TPS/PPS maximum valid value | `tpsErrorDetectionTooHigh` | % | 100 … 110 | TPS error detection: what throttle % is unrealistically high? Also used for accelerator pedal error detection if so equipped. |
| TPS/PPS Error Detection Threshold | `etbSplit` | % | 0 … 5 | TPS/PPS error threshold |
| Ford/Toyota redundant TPS mode | `useFordRedundantTps` | choice |  | On some Ford and Toyota vehicles one of the throttle sensors is not linear on the full range, i.e. in the specific range of the positions we effectively have only one sensor. |
| Secondary TPS maximum | `tpsSecondaryMaximum` | % | 0 … 100 | For Ford TPS, use 53%. For Toyota ETCS-i, use ~65% |
| Smoothing alpha (1 = off) | `tpsExpAverageAlpha` |  | 0 … 1 | Exponential smoothing applied independently to TPS1 and TPS2 on each resolved sensor read. 1 passes readings through. Lower values add smoothing and feedback delay. This is not a fixed-rate filter. |
| Fast-change reset threshold | `tpsExpAverageResetThreshold` | % | 0 … 100 | If TPS changes by at least this much within tpsExpAverageResetTimeMs, the ExpAverage filter resets and jumps straight to the new raw value instead of smoothing into it. Set to 0 to disable. |
| Fast-change reset time window | `tpsExpAverageResetTimeMs` | ms | 0 … 1000 | Time window for tpsExpAverageResetThreshold - a change of that size within this many milliseconds triggers an immediate ExpAverage reset. Set to 0 to disable. |
